summary.description: The web service model as it stands at the end of ch04.

provenance.source: ch04 — lognormal because growth compounds and cannot be negative. The p10/p90 say: surprised below 12% a year, surprised above 60%. One factor for requests and for records, because users drive both.
the refresh cycle this fleet is bought against

one_year.label: one year
one_year.note: Here because a duration cannot be an exponent. In (1+r)^n the n is a pure number, so the horizon has to be divided by something with the same units before it can be used as one. Appendix D has the rest of the conversions that bite.

provenance.source: the share of memory the kernel, the agents and the page cache floor keep before the service sees any. Triangular: a floor, a usual figure, and a host with too many agents on it
ch04 — the busy hour, not the daily mean. Triangular because this is an engineer's min/likely/max and pretending to more shape than that would be invention.
ch04 — the busy hour against the daily mean. Triangular, and it is a property of your traffic that belongs to the estate target: nothing here can measure it

ram_for_service.label: memory the service can use, per host
ram_for_service.note: Gibibytes in, decimal terabytes out — the build converts (appendix D). Declared in the unit the working set is counted in, so that the chain which divides one by the other rounds a count of hosts and not a count of hosts times nine hundred and thirty-one.

provenance.source: spec sheet: the modules fitted. The sheet says 64 GB and means GiB — appendix D — and the operating system will report less than either, which is os_reserve's job

stored_data_t0.label: records held, day one
stored_data_t0.note: This one keeps its single number. You can go and count how much you hold today. Nobody can count next quarter's busy hour. What is uncertain about the records is how fast they grow, and annual_growth carries that for the rate and the level alike.

provenance.source: stated workload (ch02) — what the service holds today: its database and the objects users have uploaded, before replication, indexes or compression

scenario.because: The same conditions the finished model is quoted under, so that a number from a stage and a number from the whole model differ only by what the stage does not contain yet.
